subject: Mini-pilot packaging & short extension options (XenithAI)
messages:
From: Elliot Chong <elliot.chong@xenithai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@xenithai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from our side: the team hit a blocker in data ingestion this week and we lost about 30% of the test volume we planned. Can we either add two weeks to the current mini-pilot or receive an equivalent token credit so we can finish the evaluation without restarting? Marta (ops) and our procurement team are copied.

We want to avoid a full restart — it would jeopardize our go/no-go timeline. Happy to take whichever option is easier for you to accommodate.

Thanks,
Elliot
Head of ML, XenithAI

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Chong <elliot.chong@xenithai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Elliot — thanks for the heads up and glad you flagged it early. Two pragmatic paths we usually offer:

1) Short-time extension: +2 weeks on the current mini-pilot (same SKU, same throughput) — no charge, but we ask for a short success checklist to confirm final evaluation dates.
2) Credit allocation: one-off token credit equivalent to the expected token usage for 2 weeks (we can calculate from your attached usage).

A couple of packaging notes that matter for you: if you choose credits, any excess beyond the credit will be billed under the existing trial rate; if you choose the extension we’ll need a PO amendment for governance (internal finance requirement for some accounts).

I attached a quick calc worksheet — can you confirm the CSV export of usage (we have a partial file here) and which path procurement prefers?

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_poc_addendum_v1.pdf (proposed addendum template)

---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Elliot Chong <elliot.chong@xenithai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Looping in a quick pricing perspective from me — if XenithAI prefers the credit approach we can offer a 15% discount on any additional token usage incurred during the extended evaluation period (this helps keep your unit economics predictable).

If you go with the extension (no additional spend), the standard ask is a short signed addendum (we've prefunded similar for other mini-pilots). Marcus

---
From: Procurement <procurement@xenithai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Thanks — Procurement here. From a vendor governance POV we prefer a credits model so we avoid amending the PO mid-flight. Two asks: 1) can you confirm the exact credit amount in USD and tokens, and 2) would Redwood be open to a conditional discount (if we convert to a paid committed plan within 60 days, apply a 10% credit back)?

Marta (ops) will follow up on the usage file.

Regards,
Procurement, XenithAI

---
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement <procurement@xenithai.com>, Elliot Chong <elliot.chong@xenithai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Thanks — good, clear asks. I ran the numbers (see attached xenithai_poc_usage.csv). Summary:

- Estimated token need for a 2-week finish: ~1.2M tokens (model mix A/B, median sequence length).
- Equivalent credit value at trial rates: $1,080 (we can tokenize as 1.2M tokens or a $1,080 credit).
- Conditional conversion incentive: Redwood can offer a 10% rebate on the credit ($108) if XenithAI signs a 6mo committed Dedicated or Hosted plan within 60 days of pilot close. The rebate would be applied as account credit after conversion.

If Procurement prefers credits I can draft a one-page credit memo and a short DocuSign addendum that captures the credit and the conditional rebate. If Procurement wants the extension with no billing change we will need the PO amendment (finance prefers that path for legal records).

Proposed next step: I’ll prepare the credit memo + DocuSign link and cc finance (Kimberly) for approval — which do you prefer?

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: xenithai_poc_usage.csv (export from your telemetry)

---
From: Elliot Chong <elliot.chong@xenithai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@xenithai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request — Request — 2-week extension or credits for mini-pilot

Jasmine — Procurement confirms: we prefer the credits path to avoid PO changes. The conditional conversion rebate (10%) is acceptable. Please send the credit memo + DocuSign and I’ll route for quick approval.

Appreciate the quick turnaround here. If we convert we’d prefer to discuss a small throughput discount on the committed plan — we’ll get that into the SOW conversation once pilot finishes.

Thanks,
Elliot
Head of ML, XenithAI

Attachment: none

---
(Internal note: finance/Legal will need to review the DocuSign addendum; Kimberly to approve final wording on the credit memo.)
